Thirteen came from events where India had won silver or bronze, or had not reached the podium. From Pranavi Urs to Lovlina Borgohain, the medal map changed even as traditional strengths remained again.

They had been threatened while trying to seek help regarding their son, who had eloped with the minor. This initiative aims to bolster support for candidate Hasirani Rath ahead of the looming Oct 6 bypolls. Adhikari stressed the necessity of alliances with minority voters and initiated aspirations for development.

title: 2 Keralam nurses among 5 killed in Saudi road accident
description: In a heartbreaking incident, Jaicymol Mathew and Jobina Johny, nurses from Kottayam, perished in a car accident in Saudi Arabia. The fatal crash occurred while they were shopping with two Tamil Nadu colleagues, leading to the vehicle overturning near Rania. All five occupants of the car died instantly. Authorities are now working on the repatriation of their remains back to Kerala.

title: Apple removes Bitchat app from India App Store after govt order
description: In a significant move, Apple has removed the decentralised messaging app Bitchat from its India App Store. This action follows a directive issued by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, citing illegal content linked to the app. Bitchat, known for its Bluetooth-based mesh networking that allows offline communication, had previously been removed in July before returning to the store. As it stands, Indian users can no longer download Bitchat.

Authorities have obtained a transit warrant to conduct deeper questioning while they assess the gravity of the leaked information and any financial exchanges involved.

description: A Scottish fossil known as Lizzie was previously considered one of the earliest reptiles. Recent X-ray scans revealed features suggesting it was more fish-like than reptilian. These findings indicate that traits associated with land adaptation developed gradually in tetrapods. Researchers now propose that clawed footprints may have belonged to amphibious relatives instead of early amniotes. This evolution redefines our understanding of early life forms transitioning from water to land.

It was later revealed that these shocking pictures were simply AI-generated hype for promotional purposes. In reality, Matthews hasn’t changed his appearance and still resembles his familiar self in recent events. This incident underscores the ease with which AI can fabricate misleading impressions and influence perceptions.
